scope.title: First real effective single-component paired ablation
scope.source: real RuntimeMemoryStore over a deterministic local fixture (no live provider)

decision.reason: Real paired ablation ran on the clean candidate: 20 cases x 3 repeats x 2 conditions (120 runs) over the real RuntimeMemoryStore; component-effect trace confirmed; effect size + 95% CI computed; verdict component-helps. No product default/lock change; no live-provider or human claim.

ablationResult.tokensAreProxy: tokens = maxFacts slots (not real model tokens)

independentVerification.kind: deterministic unit assertions + independent aggregation module test
independentVerification.detail: tests/unit/agent-dev-paired-ablation.test.ts independently asserts summarizeCondition / pairedEffect / verdict rules; the runtime test asserts the component-effect trace and non-regression invariants. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: Reversible, non-safety real component (Phase-4 type-aware eviction) vs its FIFO leave-one-out on the real RuntimeMemoryStore.
Baseline vs treatment retained/evicted sets differ; success-rate gap (0.1667 vs 1.0) is the trace.
20 cases x 3 repeats x 2 conditions, per-case seeded order, isolated store, deterministic fixture.
Success, pass^k, p50/p95, tokens proxy, false blocks, safety violations, effect size and 95% CI all reported.
Primary metric, k, minCases, degradation budget pre-registered in the fixture before the run.
Verdict derived from the CI; zero/negative effect would be reported as-is.
Unit tests 6/6, typecheck:test 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.
No product default/lock/approval change; no live provider; tokens explicitly a proxy; not real-human evidence.

notMeasured: Real model task success/tokens/cost (deterministic memory-store fixture only).
A separate second-agent independent verifier role.

landing.note: Pushed with the evidence commit in the same session; see the branch's PR.
